headline: Hurricanes activate Jordan Staal from IR, will return vs. Kraken
take:
Both teams got bodies back for the second game in Helsinki, per Daily Faceoff. Jordan Staal, last spring's Conn Smythe winner, came off injured reserve for Carolina, and Seattle activated Ryan Lindgren, returned Cale Fleury and called on Jagger Firkus for his NHL debut.

Staal's seven games so far are a strange little sample: no points on 1.21 expected goals, yet Carolina takes 68% of the 5v5 shot attempts with him out there. Last season he scored 20. The Hurricanes, 16-3-2 with 61% of the expected goals, hardly needed help, but a shutdown center makes a deep team deeper.

Seattle's returns matter less than its shape. The Kraken are 9-8-1 while getting only 43% of the expected goals, and both Lindgren (42% at 5v5) and Fleury (41%) have been underwater in that share too. Healthier, yes. Fixed, not yet.
